programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: The GLORY 33 SuperFight Series features a middleweight title fight between champion SImon Marcus and top ranked challenger Jason Wilnis. Plus a heavyweight battle between Chi Lewis Parry and Anthony McDonald.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: The Lightweight title is on the line as Sittichai looks to defend his title against #1 challenger Marat Grigorian. There is also a four-man lightweight tournament on the card.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three of the North Wests best chefs, returning contender Mary Ellen McTague, Jason Athertons protg James Durrant and ambitious new chef Mark Ellis battle it out for a place at the finals.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today the North West chefs, second timer Mary Ellen McTague, Jason Athertons protg James Durrant and fellow newcomer Mark Ellis go head to head for the fish course.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Its main course day for the North West chefs Mary Ellen McTague, James Durrant and Mark Ellis. After yesterdays disastrous fish course theyre all desperate to impress the veteran judge. But who will perfectly redeem themselves?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Its the North West chefs last chance to impress with their desserts as at the end of todays cooking one chef must leave the competition. The pressure is on as any slip up may cost the chefs a place in tomorrows regional final.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today the two remaining North West chefs cook their four courses again for the judges Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort, who must decide which chef will win a place in the finals.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: S09 : E31 London and South East Starter
programme.desc: Three of London and the South Easts superstar chefs, returning contender Adam Simmonds, Michelin-starred newcomer Tom Sellers and his former boss Adam Byatt, attempt to dazzle the mystery judge with their starter courses.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: S09 : E32 London and South East Fish
programme.desc: Today the London and South East chefs, returning contender Adam Simmonds, Michelin starred newcomer Tom Sellers and his former boss Adam Byatt continue their battle.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: S09 : E33 London and South East Mains
programme.desc: The London and South East chefs Adam Simmonds, Tom Sellers and Adam Byatt go head to head cooking their main courses.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: S09 : E34 London and South East Dessert
programme.desc: Today its dessert course as the London and South East chefs compete for one of two places in the judges chamber tomorrow and the competition couldnt be tighter. Whoever scores the lowest will be going home.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: S09 : E35 London and South East Judging
programme.desc: Its a tightly fought battle today as the two remaining London and South East chefs cook all four of their dishes again for the judges Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week three of the Central regions top chefs, returning champion Aktar Islam, Daniel Cliffords protg Mark Poynton and ambitious newcomer Jason Hodnett go into battle.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Returning champion Aktar Islam, Daniel Cliffords protg Mark Poynton and ambitious newcomer Jason Hodnett fight it out for fish course glory. After plating up late yesterday will Aktar manage to be on time today?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today the Central region chefs Aktar Islam, Mark Poynton and Jason Hodnett go head to head cooking their main courses for the veteran judge. With Mark and Aktar fighting for the lead can Jason sneak under the radar to take them by surprise?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Its dessert day and the Central chefs Aktar Islam, Mark Poyton and Jason Hodnett are all striving for one of two spots in tomorrows regional final. Will Jasons elaborate chocolate medal dessert see him triumph or sent home empty handed?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today the two remaining Central region chefs cook all four courses again for the judges Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort. At the end of the day one chef will advance to the national finals.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today its the starter course and as the chefs arrive they discover theres added competition following the London and South East regions shock result.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Its the fish course and those chefs who didnt make it onto the shortlist with their starters yesterday are hoping to do better today. Who will be in with a chance of cooking their fish course at the banquet?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Its the half-way point in finals week and those chefs who have yet to get a dish onto the shortlist are feeling the heat. With nine dishes tasted and the scores in, theres a shock result for the chefs.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: When the Dessert result is in its down to the judges to pick the perfect menu from all four courses shortlists. Which chef will triumph to cook the starter, fish, main and dessert at the D Day banquet?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The banquet is finally here. Its the culmination of months of hard work as the winning four chefs strive to deliver their dishes to an expectant audience of wartime heroes at St Pauls Cathedral, a bastion of British wartime resilience.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today three top chefs from Scotland all competition newcomers are out to impress this weeks veteran judge and be crowned Scottish champion.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today three newcomers to the competition create their fish dishes in a bid to be crowned Scottish champion. The standard is so high the veteran judge is moved to tears.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week three of Scotlands finest chefs are competing to be crowned champion. All week Ally McGrath has been keeping the veteran judge entertained with his very individual approach.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today one chef will go home and today the veteran judge finds himself with a very difficult decision to make. Inventive Chef Michael Bremner is recreating the Scottish deserts of his childhood inspired by a local hero honoured by the Queen.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today is the head to head. Scotlands two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort, for the very first time.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today it is the starter course of the South West Regional heat. Chef Josh Eggleton is back for a third time. Josh is the Michelin star chef proprietor at The Pony and Trap near Bristol.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: There are some exciting dishes on the menu today as the three chefs from the South West a region renowned for its seafood - tackle the fish course.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the main course and Chef Chris Wheeler is out to show just how theatrical he can be, his ideas are surprising everyone in the kitchen. No one knows quite what to expect and the veteran chef is hoping it tastes as good as it looks.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today is the dessert course and it is Josh Eggleton who has come up with the most ambitious dessert. He is creating his own self-serve ice cream made from vegetables, he is making everything from scratch.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today is the head to head. The South West regions two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort and today they are joined by guest judge, journalist and restaurant critic, Grace Dent.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week two newcomers to the competition are challenging reigning North West champion Matt Worswick. Adam Reid is Head Chef for one of the UKs leading culinary talents Simon Rogan, heading up Simons The French restaurant at Manchesters Midland hotel.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the fish course and reigning NW champion Matt Worswick has reason to be confident. Last year his fish course was shortlisted for the banquet in the national finals.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the main course of the North West Regional heat and the scores mean this is a crucial round. Matt Worswick may be the reigning champion but he is not yet assured of a place cooking for the judges and he is feeling the strain.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Its the dessert course and the three North West competitors are getting highly creative producing some of the most original and stunning desserts.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today the two chefs are cooking for judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton. Its the dessert course that seals the fate of the chefs and the North West Champion is revealed.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today three of the finest chefs from Wales are competing to be crowned champion. Two chefs are back for a second time: Phil Carmichael and Adam Bannister. Adam was crowed Welsh champion last year so this year Phil is back with something to prove.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today is the fish course and newcomer Andrew Birch is confident, he is passionate about seafood. Adam Bannister has created a modern take on the old boil in the bag fish dinners and Phil has chosen to revamp the classic prawn cocktail.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week three of finest chefs from Wales are competing to be crowned champion. Returning Chef, Phil Carmichael is serving up his version of an O.B.E, a refined take on onions, bacon and egg.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week in the Welsh heat newcomer Andrew Birch is challenging two returning chefs, Adam Bannister and Phil Carmichael. It is the dessert course and one chef will go home.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today is the head to head. The two highest scoring chefs from Wales are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort who are joined by guest judge, blogger and food writer Rosie Birkett.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three newcomers are competing to become regional Central champion - Daniel Smith, Andrew Scott and Danny Gill. Danny Gill is a former head chef at Daniel Cliffords two star restaurant Midsummer House.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the fish course and the chefs are using some of the UKs best seafood: lobster, salmon and Cornish crab. Daniel Smith may be classically trained but hes decided to take a risk adding a cheese custard to his lobster dish.

programme.title: Great British Menu

Youll find plenty of action and suspense in this vintage horse opera, originally distributed by the kings of the B western, Monogram Pictures!

programme.title: Vengeance Valley

John Drew Barrymore stars as Cooncat, a troubled young man who has to steal to survive. With no friends in West Texas, he falls in with some bad customers who involve him in some terrible crimes. The strong cast includes Chill Wills, Jack Elam, and John Archer, with cinematography by Oscar winner W. Howard Greene.

programme.title: Wagon Trail

Sheriff Hartley suspects him, but has been unable to gather the needed evidence. Collins instructs his gang, including young Hartley, to hold up the stagecoach on its return trip from Missionary Flats and take the cargo of gold dust it is carrying. Sheriff Hartley is notified of the planned holdup by one of his deputies who has been spying on Collins, and organizes a posse. A deputy-sheriff is killed in the ensuing gunfight between the lawmen and the outlaws, but Deputy Joe Larkin, pursues and...

programme.title: The Dude Ranger
programme.desc: Its nothing but action and thrills when an Easterner inherits a cattle ranch and discovers that thousands of cattle have been stolen. Secretly, he signs on as a hired hand at his own ranch to uncover the thief. Once he realizes whats going on, the city boy becomes a hard-riding, avenging son of a six- shooter! Directed by Edward F. Cline from a story by Zane Grey, the film stars George OBrien, Irene Hervey, and LeRoy Mason.

programme.title: Sitting Bull
programme.desc: A cavalry officer sympathetic to the wronged Sioux tribe fixes a meeting between Chief Sitting Bull and President Grant but a dishonest Indian Agent and a hateful General Custer test the Siouxs patience, threatening to derail the peace-talks. Directed and co-written by Sidney Salkow; starring Dale Robertson, Mary Murphy, J. Carrol Naish. Also, look for legendary character actor Iron Eyes Cody as Crazy Horse.

programme.title: Young Bill Hickock
programme.desc: Roy Rogers stars as the title character in this actionpacked feature from Republic Pictures. Starring Sally Payne as Calamity Jane, and Rogerss ongoing sidekick George Gabby Hayes, this twofisted saga relives some of Americas most colorful days, and also has time for a few musical numbers, including Up and Down the Prairie, and When the Shadows Fall Across the Rockies.

programme.title: Revenge of the Virgins (Edited Version)
programme.desc: The angry and topless female members of a Native American prepare for battle when white treasure hunters move in on their sacred ground. Peter Perry Jr. (The Secret Sex Lives of Romeo and Juliet) directed this early nudie-cutie from a script by legendary cult filmmaker Ed Wood (Plan Nine from Outer Space). Writing under the pen name Peter LaRoche, Wood churned out this screenplay just before he reinvented himself as the author of seedy adult novels.

programme.desc: In this episode, Sharon Bender intends to marry Adam over the objections of wealthy father Dan. When Dans killing is announced, Adam is jailed and a lynch mob forms. The Judge and Taggart have their doubts wondering if a murder even occurred. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: While attempting to steal land from an Indian tribe, crooked ranchers kill one of the braves. The Judge must move fast to prevent an all-out massacre. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.desc: When the Peters family, seemingly angry at the world and desiring nothing but to be left alone, arrives in Diablo, Annie, Tagg and Lofty try to find out what is making the Peters family act so hostile. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.desc: Hawkeye and Chingachcook go up against two thieves with stolen identities. Hawkeye: John Hart. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: After Farmer Perkins murders a store clerk in front of his wife, and is allowed to walk after his trial, the Cartwrights step in to make sure hell be rearrested, tried, and hung.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Home in Oklahoma
programme.desc: The entire gang is here! Roy Rogers, Dale Evans, Gabby Hayes, and Trigger are all involved in a murder mystery involving the death of a wealthy ranch owner. Songs include I Wish I Was A Kid Again and Cowboy Ham and Eggs.

programme.title: Arizona Bound
programme.desc: The Rough Riders are called upon to help save a stagecoach line. From 1941, starring Buck Jones and Tim McCoy, plus Horace Murphy and Luana Walters. Directed by Spencer Bennett.

programme.title: Code of the Fearless
programme.desc: Fred Scott plays a lawman who goes undercover to expose a dangerous gang of criminals in this action-packed drama. He also has time to sing three songs: Cactus Pete, Gonna Ride, and Heres Romance. Screenwriter Fred Myton would go on to write such offbeat features as Nabonga, and Border Phantom.

programme.title: Tumbleweeds
programme.desc: The great William S. Hart stars in this classic tale of settlers in the Oklahoma territory. Directed by King Baggot, one of the most versatile movie figures of the silent era, this movie is not only history recorded in heart throbs, as the original print ads boasted, but shows us why Hart is considered by some to be the top western actor of them all. Hart, who directed many of his own films, also had a hand in directing this feature, which turned out to be his last starring role.

programme.title: Cowboy And The Prizefighter
programme.desc: Red Ryder takes Steve Stevenson, who has saved his life, to his ranch and gives him a job. Reds aunt, the Duchess, knew Steves father, who supposedly committed suicide after losing his ranch betting on a prizefight. Steve refuses to believe that his father took his own life, suspecting he was murdered. Red and Little Beaver aid Steve in finding his father killer.

programme.title: Blue Steel
programme.desc: Undercover US Marshal John Carruthers (John Wayne) is investigating a rash of robberies by a character known as The Polka Dot Bandit in this B-movie gem. Along the way, Carruthers finds himself in more trouble than hed ever expected! Written and directed by Robert N. Bradbury, the film features George Gabby Hayes, Eleanor Hunt, and many other favorites of the era. Wayne was only 27 at the time of Blue Steel, but was well on his way to becoming The Duke.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: A love story and a search for gold in the Valley of Death! Dubbed simple, powerful and dramatic by the New York Times on the date of its release, Death Valley is indeed an elegant depiction of love and deception in the American desert during the Gold Rush. In what was to be the final film of famed silent film director Paul Powell (Polyanna), a cast of mostly unknown actors produces uniformly excellent work. Lyrical and graceful, Powells film spins the tale of a young boy who finds love and gold, only to have it stolen from him.

programme.title: Outpost In Morocco
programme.desc: George Raft, Mary Windsor, and Akim Tamiroff star in this romantic drama from director Robert Florey (The Florentine Dagger, Daughter of Shanghai). Raft plays Capt. Gerard, a member of the Foreign Legion known for his romantic entanglements. Hes assigned to escort an emirs daughter to her fathers mountain citadel and learn about the emirs activities. Not surprisingly, Gerard finds trouble brewing! With footage shot in Morocco, this movie also features a beautiful musical score by twotime Oscar nominee Michel Michelet (Voice in the Wind).

programme.title: Cheyenne Rides Again
programme.desc: Get ready for thundering thrills! A lawman (Tom Tyler) pretends to be an outlaw, steals $10,000 from a cattle thief, then promises to return the money if he can join the gang. Meanwhile, his real mission is to expose the bad guys! Lon Chaney Jr stars appears in one of his early roles for director Robert F. Hill (Shadow of Chinatown; Flash Gordon).

programme.title: The Fighting Redhead
programme.desc: When a rustler named Faro kills one of his own henchmen and blames it on Sheila OConner, Red and Little Beaver set out to clear Sheila and to find evidence against Faro and his gang.

programme.title: Arizona Thunderbolt
programme.desc: When Sue Bixby becomes his new boss, stagecoach robber Talbot reforms and goes after her rustled cattle. When he and his men are outnumbered fighting Lloyds gang, Randall rides to get circus man Mahoney and his man shooting cannon.

programme.title: Abilene Town
programme.desc: Ablaze with guns and guts and glory! Randolph Scott headlines as a star studded cast in this yarn about battling homesteaders. Director Edwin L. Marin (Tall in the Saddle) spins this dramatic post-Civil War tale that takes place in the legendary cow town of Abilene, Kansas, coaxing fine performances from the likes of Ann Dvorak, Edgar Buchanan, Thonda Fleming, and Lloyd Bridges. Saddle up and hang on!

programme.title: Raiders of the Border
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Nevada Jack McKenzie (Johnny Mack Brown) and Sandy Hopkins (Raymond Hatton) go undercover to catch jewelry smugglers in this vintage western from Monogram Pictures. This was one of the last films directed by John P. McCarthy (Song of the Gringo, The Oklahoma Cyclone), while Johnny Mack Brown would go on to find great success as Nevada Jack; this was the fourth of 19 films where he played the crime busting marshal.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat and Stoney are ordered to San Pablo, Mexico, to find out whats behind the trouble an American tungsten mine is having. When they arrive, they discover the mine has been closed, the wells are all poisoned and the town is in the grip of a malaria epidemic. To make matters worse, the lawmen have been followed by four gunslingers determined to give the American troubleshooters all the trouble they can handle - and more. Russell Hayden stars.

He was too darned tough to sing! Also starring Nora Lane, Ben Corbet; directed by Sam Newfield.

This campy western from 1931 stars Lane Chandler and is sure to keep you enthralled from beginning to end. Directed by Armand Schaefer; starring Marie Quillan and Walter Miller.

Fraser (The Last of the Clintons, Rustlers Paradise) directs a strong cast of familiar faces, including legendary sidekick George Gabby Hayes, Earl Dwyer, and one of the hardest ridin stuntmen turned actors, Yakima Canutt.

programme.title: The Last Border
programme.desc: På en genomgripande fororenad planet återstår endast några få beboeliga zoner. Vid polcirkeln finns en ren region, vars invånare kampar for overlevnad mot en militarjunta och laglosa gerillagang. Livet har forvandlats till en kamp, och faror lurar overallt. Men den farligaste av mannen ar den som redan har forlorat allt.

programme.title: Papperstjarnan
programme.desc: "Pappersstjarnan" ar baserad på verkliga handelser. Det handlar om en fotomodell, hennes tre man, ett dekadent liv, utnyttjande och offentlig kritik. Anna (Pirkko Hamalainen) ar en fore detta miss, nu en toppmodell, vars liv spårar ur på grund av mannen. Anna blir så småningom foremål for utnyttjande av både den skumma affarsmannen Ulf (Hannu Lauri) och den alkoholiserade och våldsamma fotografen Ilja (Kari Vaananen). Den enda riktiga vannen visar sig vara Taukka (Matti Rasila), som har en modig installning till livet. Anna beslutar sig for att forsoka fly från de svåra delarna av sitt liv, men det kraver modiga beslut och beredskap att betala deras pris.

programme.title: Ariel
programme.desc: Taisto jobbar i en gruva i norra Finland. Nar gruvan stangs reser han mot Helsingfors i en vrakig cabriolet som han ovantat får. Men problemen tornar upp sig. Han blir rånad, hittar inget jobb och doms till fangelse for misshandel. Men med hjalp av sin flickvan Irmeli, en ensamstående mor han traffar i Helsingfors och sin cellkamrat planerar Taisto att bryta sig ur fangelset och starta om på nytt. Aki Kaurismaki ar kand for sina socialrealistiska skildringar och svarta karleksforklaringar till ett dystert Finland. Filmer med komiska och omsinta inslag.

programme.title: Programmet fortsatter strax
programme.desc: Vi tar igen vår skonhetssomn! Stanna kvar for mer prisvard underhållning utvald av Rakuten TV.

programme.title: En tomtesaga
programme.desc: I Lappland for hundra år sedan forlorade lille Nikolas sin familj i en olycka. Byns invånare tog gemensamt hand om pojken. Varje jul flyttade han till en ny familj och for att visa sin tacksamhet gav Nikolas en gång per år presenter till familjernas barn. Men nar Nikolas fyllde 13 år tvingades han borja jobba hos Isak, en bitter snickare som forbjod honom att gora presenter...

programme.title: Ljus i skymningen (Lights in the Dusk)
programme.desc: Aki Kaurismakis film om nattvakten Koistinen som forlorar jobbet, friheten och drommarna. Men till sist skonjer han en strimma hopp.

programme.title: Skuggor i paradiset
programme.desc: Nikander ar en ensam sopbils-chauffor som en dag moter den anspråkslosa snabbkopskassorskan Ilona. Nikander blir blixtrande kar, men deras omsesidiga blyghet medfor att det romantiska lyser med sin frånvaro. Så plotsligt andras livet… Ilona får sparken och de bestammer sig for att traffas på ett mysigt litet motell. Aki Kaurismaki ar kand for sina socialrealistiska skildringar och svarta karleksforklaringar till ett dystert Finland. Filmer med komiska och omsinta inslag.

programme.title: Odd Man Rush
programme.desc: Odd Man Rush ar baserad på Bill Keenans bastsaljande sjalvbiografi med samma namn. Filmens Bobby Sanders flyttar från Harvards hockeylag till div. 1 i Sverige, i en deal som inbegriper en tvattmaskin och torktumlare. Hans romantisk relation med en tjej i ortens mataffar tvingar honom att se livets realiteter i ogonen och rejalt fundera om barndomsdrommen att spela i NHL ar realistisk.

programme.title: Carambole
programme.desc: En man kor på en 14-årig pojke som dor ogonblickligen. Det ar morkt och regnigt och han smiter från olycksplatsen. Ett misstag som han bittert får ångra och som forandrar hela hans liv. For Van Veeteren blir det ett fall som drabbar honom personligen, ett fall som kostar honom en av sina karaste...

programme.title: Moln på drift
programme.desc: Ilona och Lauri ar ett stravsamt par som inte begar mycket av livet. Tak over huvudet, mat på bordet, ett glas vin och en kvall framfor tv-n. De arbetar plikttroget och agnar sina korta ledigheter åt varandra och sin hund. Men en dag hander något som hotar att slå deras trygga tillvaro i spillror. En varm och absurd historia om ett alldeles vanligt par någonstans i Finland.

programme.title: Amazon
programme.desc: Den finske mannen Kari (Kari Vaananen) bestemmer seg for å flytte til Brasil med sine to døtre etter kona hans dør. Snart møter han den eventyrlystne amerikanske flygeren Dan (Robert Davi: Die Hard), som forteller Kari om planen sin om å grave etter gull i Amazonas-jungelen. Men Kari møter også den vakre Paola (Rae Dawn Chong: Commando), som lærer ham mer om situasjonen i Amazonas og truslene mot den.

programme.title: Vinski och osynlighetspulvret
programme.desc: Vinski och osynlighetspulvret utspelas i den fiktiva staden Hompstad, som skakas av en brottsvåg. Inbrott och rån har blivit en del av stadsbornas vardag och det behovs en riktig superhjalte for att hjalpa polisen. Skolpojken Vinski (Kuura Rossi) lar kanna den mystiske apotekaren (Martti Suosalo), som erbjuder Vinski mojligheten att bli Hompstads hjalte. Apotekarens hemlighet ar ett pulver, som gor personen osynlig och ger mojlighet att gå genom vaggar. Med hjalp av osynlighetspulvret skulle Vinski kunna avsloja en hemlig rånarliga och dess ledare, med endast ett par gula handskar som ledtråd.

programme.title: De arvlosa
programme.desc: Mika Kaurismaens forsta långfilm. Han skrev manuset tillsammans med sin bror Aki. "De arvlosa" ar en tidlos skildring av hur småskurken Manne, bonddrangen Harri och den vackra Veera kor en Volga genom de forsvinnande finlandska landskapen, med poliser och gangsters standigt på halarna. Den fartfyllda resan ackompanjeras av tidlosa låtar av bland annat Juice och Rauli Badding.

programme.title: Lognaren
programme.desc: Lognaren ar en beskrivning av en ung skojare som aldrig talar sanning. Den unge mannen spelad av Aki Kaurismaki vandrar genom Helsingfors gator och forsoker låna pengar från bekanta och framlingar med olika forevandningar. Lognaren ar Mika Kaurismakis debutfilm och hans examensarbete från Munchens filmskola.

programme.title: Hamlet i affarsvarlden
programme.desc: Efter sin faders dod arver Hamlet en styrelseplats i ett gummiforetag. Hamlets farbror kontrollerar foretaget och bestammer sig for att de ska satsa på en ny marknad, namligen gummiankor. Men den nyblivne styrelsemedlemmen ar misstanksam, framforallt over omstandigheterna kring faderns dod. Aki Kaurismaki regisserar har en smått bisarr ”film-noir” variant av Shakespeares HAMLET. Aki Kaurismaki ar kand for sina socialrealistiska skildringar och svarta karleksforklaringar till ett dystert Finland. Filmer med komiska och omsinta inslag.

programme.title: Bieffekterna
programme.desc: Forskarstudenten Julia och programmeraren Rebecca ingår i ett elitteam vid Lunds universitet. De jobbar med den kontroversiella vetenskapliga metoden biohacking, genteknikens nya hopp som kan betyda slutet for dodliga sjukdomar i vår livstid.

programme.title: 30:e november
programme.desc: Adam och hans polare spenderar sin tid med att trakassera invandrare som de hatar. Men så moter Adam Julia från Peru och de blir blixtforalskad, eftersom varken Adams vanner eller Julias familj skulle acceptera att de två ar tillsammans tvingas de hålla sin karlek hemlig. På Sveriges nationaldag drabbas Adam och hans gang samman med Julias bror, Sascha, och hans vanner. Det hela slutar med att två dodads.

programme.title: Layers of Lies
programme.desc: Nar han återvander till Iran efter många år i exil i Finland, finner Sam (Ramin Sohrab) att han annu inte har flytt från sitt forflutna. En skum figur kidnappar hans fru Emma (Jessica Wolff) for att dra in honom i ett våldsamt plan for hamnd. Men Sam ar en obeveklig kampmaskin som inte kommer att stoppa någonting for att radda kvinnan han alskar. Nar det galler att bestamma sin framtid kommer det forflutna inte att stå i vagen for dem... Layer of Lies ar en adrenalinfylld spanningstur genom den livliga, mångsidiga metropolen Teheran.

programme.title: Nicks Film
programme.desc: Lightning Over Water ar en rorande film om den amerikanske kultregissoren Nicholas Rays sista dagar. Ray var mest kand for filmen “Rebel Without a Cause”.Jag visste att han onskade att arbeta, och do medan han arbetade”, sager Wim Wenders i filmen. Och genom sitt arbete med Wenders och ovriga medarbetare, forvandlade Ray sin dod till ett samarbetsprojekt och ett konstverk. Han reflekterar over sitt livs prestationer, misslyckanden och kompromisser. Han berattar minnen om Joan Crawford, James Dean och de många andra Hollywood-stjarnorna som var med i hans filmer.

programme.title: Tusen timmar
programme.desc: Svensk-danska filmen Tusen timmar handlar om Anna. Hon lever på drommar och soker karleken och sig sjalv. Hon har ett band med Thomas och de ar bara vanner, brukar de saga.

programme.title: Klanen - berattelsen om Grudornas slakt
programme.desc: "Klanen" ar historien om en brottslig slakt dar Mika Kaurismaki behandlar existensens villkor genom den traditionella episka formen, på gransen mellan ratt och fel i lagen. Alexander, den yngsta sonen, ar slaktens vita får. Han forvantas hålla sig på den raka vagen, till skillnad från sin far och andra man i slakten. Men familjen ar varst, och blod ar tjockare an vatten... Familjedramat "Klanen" ar en storslagen hyllning till den gamla finska filmen.

programme.title: Mannen utan minne
programme.desc: Aki Kaurismakis film om en man som tappar sitt minne och får hjalp av fattiga men storhjartade manniskor i en containerby.

programme.title: Gourmet Club
programme.desc: Filmen foljer en doktor som tillhor en grupp på fem overklassherrar som traffas varje månad i ett slutet rum på en lyxkrog. En av dem tar med sig en hemlig ingrediens som kocken tillagar och som de ovriga sedan ska forsoka identifiera. I potten ligger en summa pengar. Doktorns privata problem kommer ifatt honom och leder honom att anvanda sig av en chockerande ingrediens for att overlista de andra.

programme.title: Leningrad Cowboys go America
programme.desc: En film om varldens samsta rockband på en resa från hemknutarna i Sibirien till USA.

programme.title: En tomtesaga
programme.desc: I Lappland for hundra år sedan forlorade lille Nikolas sin familj i en olycka. Byns invånare tog gemensamt hand om pojken. Varje jul flyttade han till en ny familj och for att visa sin tacksamhet gav Nikolas en gång per år presenter till familjernas barn. Men nar Nikolas fyllde 13 år tvingades han borja jobba hos Isak, en bitter snickare som forbjod honom att gora presenter...

programme.title: Tatjana
programme.desc: Valto och Reino ger sig av på bilfard och langs vagen plockar de upp Tatjana och Klaudia. Resan går genom ett Finland som inte påverkats av Nokia eller EU utan forblivit urfinskt. Sin vana trogen levererar Kaurismaki en film utan onodig dialog. Aki Kaurismaki ar kand for sina socialrealistiska skildringar och svarta karleksforklaringar till ett dystert Finland. Filmer med komiska och omsinta inslag.

programme.title: Ljus i skymningen (Lights in the Dusk)
programme.desc: Aki Kaurismakis film om nattvakten Koistinen som forlorar jobbet, friheten och drommarna. Men till sist skonjer han en strimma hopp.

programme.title: Munsters Fall
programme.desc: En formogen vinimportor hittas brutalt mordad med ett kraftigt slag mot huvudet. Munster får fallet på sitt bord. Den huvudmisstankte ar offrets fore detta kompanjon. Munster, som till en borjan anser fallet solklart borjar emellertid tvivla. Genom att gå emot en utredning som redan ar klar riskerar han sitt eget liv.

programme.title: Cha Cha Cha
programme.desc: Den alkoholiserade Matti (Matti Pellonpaa), som bor under broarna, ar på vag att arva en betydande summa pengar från sin amerikanska faster. Men mannen måste vara representativ under fasterns besok. Matti berattar om situationen for sin van som arbetar som bilhandlare, och denne foreslår en rollbyten mot ersattning.

programme.title: Låt de doda vila
programme.desc: Jimmy ar inte bara en fan av heavy metal, skrack, och det ockulta. Han har ett mål: han vill kontakta sin avlidna mamma. Den nya killen i klassen, charmoren Amir, lockar Jimmy till att imponera skolans två snyggaste tjejer, Louise och Anna, med en liten rit. Efter riten inser Jimmy, att han har begått ett forfardligt misstag, som kan grava fram doda hemligheter och betyda hela jordens undergång.

programme.title: Fallet G
programme.desc: Van Veeterens enda olosta fall kommer upp till ytan igen nar dottern till en privatdetektiv kommer och besoker honom. En våldsam hustrumordare som forsvann under jord for flera år sedan verkar nu ha dykt upp med nytt namn och ar inblandad i ett nytt mord. Van Veeteren har såval professionella som personliga skal att satta fast honom.

programme.title: Hamlet i affarsvarlden
programme.desc: Efter sin faders dod arver Hamlet en styrelseplats i ett gummiforetag. Hamlets farbror kontrollerar foretaget och bestammer sig for att de ska satsa på en ny marknad, namligen gummiankor. Men den nyblivne styrelsemedlemmen ar misstanksam, framforallt over omstandigheterna kring faderns dod. Aki Kaurismaki regisserar har en smått bisarr ”film-noir” variant av Shakespeares HAMLET. Aki Kaurismaki ar kand for sina socialrealistiska skildringar och svarta karleksforklaringar till ett dystert Finland. Filmer med komiska och omsinta inslag.

programme.title: Bieffekterna
programme.desc: Forskarstudenten Julia och programmeraren Rebecca ingår i ett elitteam vid Lunds universitet. De jobbar med den kontroversiella vetenskapliga metoden biohacking, genteknikens nya hopp som kan betyda slutet for dodliga sjukdomar i vår livstid.

programme.desc: "allas (Erika Linder) ar trott på sin tillvaro – hon sliter som taklaggare på dagen och traffar alskarinnor på natten – samma sak varje dag. Tills hon traffar den sjalvsakra och framgångsrika moderedaktoren Jasmine på en klubb. Från forsta ogonkastet dras de som magneter till varandra, och kastar sig rakt in i en passionerad affar. programme.title: You Will Meet a Tall Dark Stranger
programme.desc: I denna stormiga komedi av Woody Allen, upptacker två par att graset inte alltid ar gronare på andra sidan. Alfie Shepridge (ANTHONY HOPKINS) dumpar sin fru sedan 40 år (GEMMA JONES), i ett forsok att återuppleva ungdomens nojen tillsammans med en ung callgirl (LUCY PUNCH). For att få ratsida på sitt liv tar den forsmådda hustrun hjalp av en spådam. Samtidigt blir deras dotter Sally (NAOMI WATTS) foralskad i sin chef (ANTONIO BANDERAS), och hennes make (JOSH BROLIN) blir besatt av skonheten som bor på andra sidan gatan (FREIDA PINTO). Och snart hanger både deras forhållanden och deras forstånd i samma skora tråd...

programme.title: Lovesick

programme.title: Never Too Late
programme.desc: Fyra veteraner som overlevt Vietnamkrigets fånglager bestammer sig for att genomfora en sista flykt – från aldreboendet. Men att planera en rymning i ett senilt gang bjuder på utmaningar. programme.title: The Right Kind of Wrong
programme.desc: Leo Palamino ar den misslyckade forfattaren som blev diskare som blev beromd for alla sina fel och brister genom bloggen “Varfor du suger”, den enorma natsuccen som skrivs av hans exfru. Leo traffar sen Colette, sin dromtjej … samma dag som hon gifter sig med den perfekte mannen. Det blir borjan på den ultimata underdog-historien nar den oradde drommaren Leo riskerar allt for att visa Colette och hela varlden allt som ar ratt med en man som ar kand for att inte ha ett enda ratt.

Allt andras nar hon hor en intervju på radion med sångaren och låtskrivaren i rockbandet Drumstrings Casey. Hon foralskar sig handlost och borjar folja honom runt nar han spelar. programme.title: The Way You Look Tonight
programme.desc: Peter narmar sig 30 och ar fortfarande vilsen svulsten efter karlek med andlosa online dater utan resultat. En nyckfull date lamnar honom ensam i sangen en morgon nar han vaknar. Peter forsoker lamna allt bakom sig och fortsatter med nya dater från samma site. Den stora frågan forblir obesvarad, kan Peter verkligen bli foralskad och hitta den akta karleken?

programme.title: My Week With Marilyn
programme.desc: I ett desperat forsok att bli tagen på storre allvar reser ikonen Marilyn Monroe (Michelle Williams) till London 1956 for att spela mot legenden Laurence Olivier i “Prinsen och balettflickan”. Den omhetstorstande Marilyn kanner sig overgiven av maken Arthur Miller och attraherad av Oliviers assistent, den unge Colin Clark. Colin blir snart Marilyns fasta och trygga punkt, samtidigt som han också blir Oliviers endahopp att kunna slutfora sin film genom sin formåga att hålla den impulsiva Marilyn i schakt. Upp over oronen foralskadar det nu Colins hjarta som riskerar att krossas av varldens storsta och vackraste filmstjarna!

programme.title: Leading Lady
programme.desc: Denna romantiska komedi berattar historien om den lovande brittiska skådespelerskan Jodi Rutherford, som overtalar Kobus Willemse, en bonde från Brandfort, om att hjalpa henne med rollen som krigshjaltinna i en storbudgetfilm. I gentjanst arrangerar Jodi den årliga konserten på Willemses gård. Jodis upplevelser i Brandfort lar henne att det finns mer i livet an Hollywoods filmvarld... eller gor det det?

programme.title: Burning Man
programme.desc: Tom ar chefskock på en chic restaurant på Bondi beach i Sydney. Han ar en arrogant typ som ser flyktigt på tillvaron. Han beter sig sjalviskt och allmant illa mot sina kollegor och sin 8-årige son Oscar, men aven mot de många kvinnorna i hans liv, exfrun Karen, kollegan Sally, psykologen Miriam, Lisa som ar lyckligt gift, prostituerade Lesley och maklaren Carol som skulle salja hans hus. Men Tom har inte alltid varit osympatisk. For tio år sedan traffade han vackra, perfekta Sarah. Hon tog fram det basta hos Tom och gav honom deras gemensamma son.

programme.title: You Will Meet a Tall Dark Stranger
programme.desc: I denna stormiga komedi av Woody Allen, upptacker två par att graset inte alltid ar gronare på andra sidan. programme.title: Granada Nights
programme.desc: En brittisk turist ar fast i Granada, Spanien, med ett brustet hjarta. Han kanner sig vilse och overgiven, blir van med en grupp utlandska studenter och kastar sig in i utbytesstudenternas varld. Han tar sig utanfor sin egen bekvamlighetszon och forsoker få en nystart i livet, men bakom varje horn lurar en påminnelse om hans fore detta flickvan, och han kampar for att hitta ett avslut. Ett karleksbrev till Granada som blandar dokumentar med fiktion for att skapa en verklig och akta skildring av hur det går till att upptacka sig sjalv. Filmad i ett unikt bildforhållande som aldrig tidigare visats på bio.

programme.title: They Came Together
programme.desc: Nar Joel (Paul Rudd) och Molly (Amy Poehler) mottes var det hat vid forsta ogonkastet: hans storbolag Godiskompaniet hotade att stanga ner hennes bohemiska godisaffar. Plus att Joel fortfarande hade kanslor for sitt sexiga ex (Cobie Smulders). Men, trots allt så blir de kara, tills dess att de gor slut och Molly borjar dejta sin revisor (Ed Helms). Men, precis i sluttampen...tja, du får se helt enkelt. (Ledtråd: Joel håller ett stort tal och de hittar tillbaka till varandra.) Från regissoren som skapade Wet Hot American Summer, Wanderlust och Role Models kommer nu en helknapp och satirisk underminering av den romantiska komedigenren.

programme.title: Date and Switch
programme.desc: Sistaårseleverna Michael och Matty har varit basta kompisar sen lågstadiet. Då de fortfarande ar oskulder sluter de en pakt att hjalpa varandra att få i sang någon innan studentbalen, men deras planer andras drastiskt nar Matt berattar att han ar homosexuell.

programme.title: Dubbelt begar
programme.desc: Dubbelt begar berattar historien om den unga kvinnan Chloe, som benagen till depression påborjar terapi och dar blir foralskad i sin psykoterapeut Paul. Efter ett par månader flyttar hon in hos sin nya alskare men upptacker snabbt att han doljer en del av sin identitet for henne.

programme.title: A Slipping Down Life
programme.desc: Evie Decker ar en ung tillbakadragen kvinna som livnar sig genom att upptrada som kanin på den lokala nojesparken. Allt andras nar hon hor en intervju på radion med sångaren och låtskrivaren i rockbandet Drumstrings Casey. Hon foralskar sig handlost och borjar folja honom runt nar han spelar. Deras olika varldar mots, och frågan ar om de kan lyckas med att kombinera sina liv till en gemensam framtid.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E16 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 16, World Finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: With new places on the calendar, over 16 stages, broadcasting in over 100 countries and in its 13th year, the MLO Strongman Champions League (SCL) can be seen truly as the biggest strongman league in the world. This competition in Portugal is full of memorable performances and strong results and this is the final!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E01 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 1, Norway
programme.desc: The spectacular Fefor Arena hosted for the 8th time the Worlds Strongest Viking, part of the SCL World Series. But with the absence of former title holders its anyones game. Again, a very spectacular episode of the Strongman Champions League here in Norway.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E02 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 2, Finland (Part 1)
programme.desc: In this episode, the Titan, former double World champion from Latvia will compete against his fellow countryman and the current World champion - Aivars Smaukstelis. With 8 events over 2 stages the contestants are pushed to their limits in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E03 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 3, Finland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Dainis Zageris and Aivars Smaukstelis, both from Latvia have a serious, strong battle in the this second and final episode of the SCL Finland 2020. Watch the unbelievable and brute power of these athletes in the last 4 events to crown the winner.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E04 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 4, World Record Breakers
programme.desc: The SCL Germany event takes place in an ancient castle called Die Burg in the heart of Germany. Its here where 5 world record attempts take place across 5 different events with 10 athletes. They will go to the max! See this and much more in the SCL Germany 2020.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E05 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 5, Strongest Viking
programme.desc: SCL Norway is normally all about snow, wind, and cold weather. Our brave athletes are used to compete under conditions few other athletes have competed in, but after COVID delays the competition has been moved from winter to summer bringing in a whole new range of challenges. With an impressive athlete list who will be the winner across 5 cruel events?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E06 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 6, World Strongest Team 1
programme.desc: Were in sunny Finland for the next stage of a double-bill of SCL action, but this time its a team event. A truly fantastic event with 6000 spectators. Even during COVID times this was exceptional! 8 Strong Teams where fighting for the title over a crazy 9 events.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E07 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 7, World Strongest Team 2
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland, done over 9 cruel events. In this episode the last and final 5 events take place. 8 Strong Teams are fighting for the title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E08 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 8, Portugal
programme.desc: The next set of challenges are set in sunny Esposende in Portugal. With stars such as Travis Ortmayer, Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland, and Ervin Toots from Estonia. While Fabio Silva will defend the honour in his own country.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E09 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 9, World Records (Part 1)
programme.desc: We are back in Germany, with the world record breakers. We promise you this is going to be amazing. Do not move from that seat, because we are going to see some records smashed today. Over 6 cruel events, you will see who gets crowned of the King Of The Castle!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E10 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 10, World Records (Part 2)
programme.desc: With the next episode of Strongman Champions League Germany. Its the world record breakers, and in the last show we set two new records. Can more be records be broken before the king of the castle is crowned?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E11 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 11, Worlds 105 Kg (Part 1)
programme.desc: Welcome to Kokkola in Finland. This city will be the setting for the Lightweight World championship. Out of 24 athletes, only 16 will make it through to the final day, but who will champion each event and who is going to be eliminated?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E12 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 12, Worlds 105 Kg (Part 2)
programme.desc: Its the second day, and the top 16 athletes have made it through to the final round. With another 4 events to go who will get the crown of world champion?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E13 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 13, Ukraine
programme.desc: Welcome to Ukraine and the wonderful capital city of Kyiv. Were here for the second time for the iconic truck pull World Championships! The reigning World champion Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland will defend his title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E14 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 14, Romania
programme.desc: In this episode, a final chance for our athletes to get vital world series ranking points on board to give them the best possible chance of success and an initial advantage at the finals. Its the last show before the world finals and the top 10 places are up for grabs, but who will they be?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E15 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 15, World Finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkeys south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season. Here in the sunshine, well finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is - you could not ask for a better setting. Aivars Smaukstellis, the reigning world champion is defending his title, and two-time world champion Dainis Zageris is also here, but with a though competition, who will win?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E16 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 16, World Finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: What a day ahead of us here in Alanya, just a handful of events to go before we find out who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League in 2021. These are the world finals, and all the big names are in the house. With just 3 events to go - who will take the crown of World Champion 2021 and be the STRONGEST?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E01 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 1, Finland Stage 1
programme.desc: We are back, after a short break it feels like we never even left. We’re here in Vaasa - Finland kicking off 2022 new world series. If you are watching at home, just like these people, you’re in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E02 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 2, Holland Part 1
programme.desc: We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. The sun is going to be beating down, they’re going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they’re all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let’s see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E03 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 3, Holland Part 2
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We’ve got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan’s Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E04 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 4, Serbia Part 1
programme.desc: We’re in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E05 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 5, Serbia Part 2
programme.desc: Welcome to day 2 in Serbia, and its another baking hot one. We are in Kikinda today! We’ve got three more gruelling events for our athletes. Sami Ahola is leading the pack, so can he be the first Finnish athlete to take an SCL title. Stay tuned to find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E06 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 6, Joensuu Part 1
programme.desc: In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They’re going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other’s strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let’s find out!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E07 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 7, Joensuu Part 2
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland- Joensuu. Welcome to the final day of the world’s strongest team event. The race to be the best team in the world is coming to its crowing point. All is still wide open for any of these to take the title. Who is going to win? Will team Latvia keep their World Title or maybe Finland can attach them? Keep watching and we’ll find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E08 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 8, Esposende
programme.desc: Welcome back to Strongman Champions League for another stage of the 2022 world tour. We’re in Esposende - Portugal in this beautiful setting next to the beach in front of a packed crowd with some of the strongest men the world has to offer. With a real Porsche deadlift and many other crazy stuff. So, lets get this show started.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E09 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 9, Great Britain
programme.desc: Hello and welcome in Gloucester, UK. The world tour hasn’t been here for what feels like forever. And now for the first time in the Mekka of Strongman, the SCL World series will crown a great Champion with the SCL Title. It will be full with special wooden events, and a great winner! So ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, brace yourselves because I present to you strongman champions league UK.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E10 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 10, Poland Part 1
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland the home of Legends Mariusz Pudzianowkski and Krzystof Radzikowski. Who will grab the title here in holiday resort Sopot, on the great Balrtic Sea with 6 events and 12 athlets in the mix!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E11 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 11, Poland Part 2
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland, after 3 events the Polish Strongman Oskar Ziolkowski is Leading. Kelvin, Travis and Aivars are coming up and will try to beat him, but will Oskar take his first title ever?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E12 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 12, Bosnia
programme.desc: it’s been a long time since the world series held a championship here in Sarajevo. Let’s see what test of strength this destination holds for our athletes. And what fantastic athletes are here again in Stage 12 of the SCL World Series. The strongman champions league Bosnia is another iconic Strongman event with the return of Rongo Keen from Australia and Portugal winner 2022 George Sulaiman.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E13 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 13, Romania
programme.desc: Welcome to Sibiu in Romania. It’s an important day for some of these athletes, because four of them have a real chance of getting into our all-exclusive world finals. There’s only one more stage after this to get those all-important extra points. So, there’s going to be some fireworks, who will take the title here and who will qualify for the World Finals?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E14 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 14, Gibraltar
programme.desc: This is it the last show before the world final. These guys have really got to fight for the points now, this is going to be action packed, whilst these guys fight it out all day.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E15 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 15, Turkey Part 1
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkey’s south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season of Strongman Champions League. Here in the sunshine, we’ll finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is. You could not ask for a better setting. After months of hard-work, if not years for some of these lads, we find out who will take the world title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E16 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 16, Turkey Part 1
programme.desc: Welcome, to day two of the strongman champions league 2022 finals here in Alanya, Turkey. It’s all up for grabs now, everyone is fighting for the world title belt. This is an epic episode where we finally crown the World champion of 2022.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E01 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 1 - Finland
programme.desc: Welcome to the 2023 Strongman Champions League in Vaasa, Finland! This year’s event introduces a knockout format with 6 intense events over 90 minutes, ending in a unique deadlift face-off with boats.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E02 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 2 - Serbia
programme.desc: Stage 2 of the Strongman Champions League 2023 is set in Zrenjanin, Serbia. This exciting event features 5 challenging contests, including a superhuman Yoke race. As the SCL World Series Tour continues, athletes will battle it out to claim the yellow leader’s position for the season. Don’t miss this incredible stage of strength and endurance!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E03 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 3 - Finland Teams World
programme.desc: The World’s Strongest Team will be crowned in this edition of SCL, here in Kalajoki-Finland we’ve picked some of the best in the business, teamed them up, and they’ll be going all out against each other. It’s now no longer about being a lonely wolf, but more about the pack mentality. It is a competition over 7 events, including a Big 2-man Log lift and heavy deadlift. Let’s start the action.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E04 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 4 - Holland
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League in Holland at the Dru Factory in ULFT. A great location for a spectacular battle with 14 Athletes over 3 events! The first 3 events in this episode are Truckpull/ Superyoke and Farmerswalk, with 2 massive logs of 150 kg in their hands. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it’s the circus of the extreme.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E05 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 5 - Holland 2023
programme.desc: Ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, strongman fans across the world, we are back for SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it’s about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland, continues with the last 3 events, here at the Dru Factory in ULFT. The events in this episode are the Viking Press, Wheel Flip and the Atlas Stones, with 180 kg in the end.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E06 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 6 - Worlds Strongest Latino
programme.desc: For the first time ever, the World’s Strongest Latino competition has begun. This two-day event in Porto, Portugal, features 20 athletes from around the world competing in 8 events. After 4 grueling events, the top 12 will advance to the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E07 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 7 - Finland World Record Breakers
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League World Record Breakers 2023 starts with a 25-ton snow plow! Crazy machines are pulled and pushed, with many kilograms moved. A few new world records are set in this competition.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E08 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 8 - Portugal
programme.desc: We have returned to the powerhouse of Portugal for an edge-of-your-seat galactic battle. If all the planets collided at once, it wouldn’t compare to the bang of this show. Get ready for the battle of the beasts; it’s the heaviest show in the universe, the Strongman Champions League.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E09 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 9 - England
programme.desc: SCL UK has landed in Gloucester it is workout war fitness for the ferocious, it’s going to be a a battle of the brutal, a rampage of the roofless. This is going to be a massacre of the muscles. You know it by now, but just in case you don’t, this is strongman champions league.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E10 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 10 - Worlds Strongest Viking
programme.desc: On the menu this week it’s medieval madness, we’ve come back to the middle ages to test our noble men through a muscle gaining of events. They are hoping and we are hoping that one will survive to take the title of the world’s strongest Viking. The official Worlds Strongest Viking is this time in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This week is a good one, can you feel the energy? Sit still, just look at me and try and feel the energy, because I can tell you, the atmosphere here is electric, it’s explosive, there is a pure elemental force going through these athletes veins. I’m shaking because it’s Poland, it’s powerful, it’s strongman champions league, and you know what Im going to say, get ready because it’s about to get heavy.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Poland part 2 - Who will win the title in Poland and take 25 points for the world ranking. It is very exciting on the top, in part 1 between Poland and Latvia. Another great episode with super strongman events such as: Bag Toss Medley, Log Lift Reps and the Powerstairs. Also an interview with Mateusz Kieloszkowski, the all time favorite champion from Poland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: It’s time to show our strength and gain respect from the gods of Olympus. Our gladiators have many events set out by no other than Hercules himself. The coliseum is ready here on this mythological island of Cyprus, so we have landed in Limassol were again 12 Top Strongmen are battling for the title and ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E14 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 14 - South Africa
programme.desc: The only and official world championship Truckpulling for its 10th year, again at the Strongman Champions league. With the 3 times Worldchampion Kelvin de Ruiter – defending his title. This championship has trucks in all shapes and sizes which is a lot like our athletes, there all different pay loads, but does the biggest win or is it the strongest.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E15 Stage 15 - SCL World Finals Bosnia
programme.desc: Years and years of determination has brought us here today, when all the walls felt like they were caving in perseverance. When their bodies were screaming, hurting, shouting stop, beneath. These are the things which make up a man, these are the things that bring you world finalists. This episode they fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E16 Stage 16 - SCL World Finals Bosnia
programme.desc: Part 2 of the World Finals of the Strongman Champions League tour 2023 at the Sarajevo Centar Skenderija in Bosnia. 3 Events was done already and amazing results have been set. Who will be the new World champion? Find out here, who, after 16 stages, will be crowned World Champion 2023.

programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: It is time to upsize! Daryls client is moving away from downtown Toronto because they desire a bigger space, more privacy, and tranquility. Daryl knows all about tranquility and goes golfing with Mike to discuss his client and Mikes listing for them.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: Mikes couple is looking for their luxurious dream home anywhere in between Toronto and Barrie near HWY 400 in a prestigious neighborhood. They have a large dog, tall family, and want to start a family of their own. This means they are going to need a lot of space and want the house to be fully renovated or brand-new. Mike is the perfect agent for this couple because he lives, eats, and breathes the luxury lifestyle.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: An amazing beachfront property is what Inezs couple is looking for and these top million dollar agents are sure to surpass their expectations. Inezs client currently lives in a condo and have one child, however, they desire a home that they can comfortably expand their family in.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: Mikes friend invites him to an Indian wedding and tells him about his uncle who is looking for a luxury condo close to the airport. Daryl, Inez, and Jin support and donate to Mikes charity after winning a bet amongst them and the amount is determined by how long Mike lasts in the ring boxing against a professional. This client is looking for an investment property and a place for him to live when visiting.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: A young trendy couple wants to start a family in Toronto but they need some help from these top million dollar agents. Jin is a natural daredevil and has always wanted to skydive with her clients. In Oakville, Jin practices at iFly that is an indoor skydiving facility. Jins client lives a very active and busy lifestyle so they require somewhere with low maintenance but still has enough space for a big family. Inez takes Jin to her hair stylist Anastasia for some business and pleasure.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: Moving in together can be stressful but fun because you are starting a new life together! Inezs client is selling their separate properties and looking for a house or condo in the city or beach area that is close to shopping, groceries, schools, etc. Inezs couple is not too picky and open to different kinds of properties. Daryl and Inez enjoy a beautiful bike ride along the beaches boardwalk to discuss her client and the perfect luxury listing he has found.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: Agreeing on a vacation home is made much harder when these top million dollar agents have astounding listings. Mikes client is looking for a waterfront cottage with lots of land and privacy. What better way to check out some waterfront listings then from a helicopter? Debbie wants a family cottage that feels homey, however, Paul wants an impressive high-end cottage that he can bring his business clients to.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: Remarrying is hard enough let alone combining two families under one roof. With a total of 4 children between the ages of 7 and 16 Jins client is definitely going to need lots of space and land in a safe neighborhood. Daryl, Inez, and Mike attend Jins band practice to support her and listen to the set list they have prepared for an upcoming charity event. Jin gets her nails done frequently and this time Daryl decides to join her for some much needed pampering.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.sub-title: S01 : E12 Top Million Dollar Agent
programme.desc: Many people enjoy staying busy and always having a project on the go. Inezs client loves to build and create breathtaking properties. On their next project, this couple wants an interesting property, preferably waterfront, which they can use for an investment property or to build on. Inez takes her client on a private yacht so they can cruise around Lake Ontario and discuss the clients wish list.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent

programme.desc: Deborah and Vezi are an international couple that want to live in Toronto for one year but has no idea where to start looking. Mike arranges a private plane for all four agents to go to Montreal and discuss in style what the client is looking for.

programme.desc: Doug (David Tennant) och Abi (Rosamund Pike) ar två helt vanliga foraldrar med tre charmiga men valdigt excentriska barn. Nar det hårda foraldralivet hotar deras mentala halsa och aktenskap så bestammer de sig for att ta med barnen på en resa till Skottland till ett stort slaktkalas och for att halsa på Dougs minst sagt knappa pappa Gordie (Billy Connolly). Det som skulle bli en forsoningsresa forvandlas snabbt till ett hysteriskt roligt socialt katastrofområde nar osamja,

programme.title: The Dresser
programme.desc: En odesdiger natt på en liten engelsk teater under andra varldskriget, satter en trupp med kringresande skådespelare upp Shakespeares "King Lear".

programme.title: Cha Cha Cha
programme.desc: Den alkoholiserade Matti (Matti Pellonpaa), som bor under broarna, ar på vag att arva en betydande summa pengar från sin amerikanska faster. Men mannen måste vara representativ under fasterns besok. Matti berattar om situationen for sin van som arbetar som bilhandlare, och denne foreslår en rollbyten mot ersattning.

programme.title: Promised Land
programme.desc: Det har dramat foljer två skolkamrater, Hancock och Danny, efter examen. Hancock och hans flickvan som ar en cheerleader ger sig ivag till medelklassens tillhåll utom rackhåll for Danny och hans psykotiska fru Bev.

programme.title: Saints Of War
programme.desc: Jersey, 1942. Hitler starker sitt grepp om Vasteuropa och Kanaloarna blir ockuperade. Tyskarna anvander Jersey som en bas dar krigsfångar slavarbetar i arbetslager och Jerseys invånare står infor en osaker framtid med radsla som frestar på humor och testar lojaliteter bland de tatt sammansvetsade i ons samhalle.

programme.title: Tillbaka till Yorkshire
programme.desc: Arthur Morrison får reda på att han har cancer och att han bara har några veckor kvar att leva. Hans vuxna son Blake reser till Yorkshire for att bo hos sin mamma i byn dar han vaxte upp. Nar Arthurs tillstånd forvarras ser Blake tillbaka på sitt forhållande med pappan. Han minns saker de gjort tillsammans, fortroligheten mellan dem och aven de forbistringar de haft. Nar fadern dor borjar Morrison fundera kring det band de haft. Han ger tydligt uttryck for motsattningar, frustration, karlek och forlust som alla ar delar i det komplicerade forhållande som finns mellan en far och hans son.

programme.title: Hollywoods hemlighet
programme.desc: 1924 samlade mediamogulen William Randolph Hearst några av varldens mest kanda personligheter for en resa med sin yacht som resulterade i ett mord som forblev olost.

programme.title: Staden Ember
programme.desc: Det har gått 200 år sedan den sista manniskan sokte skydd i den underjordiska staden Ember; men nu sviktar den stora generatorn.

programme.title: De arvlosa
programme.desc: Mika Kaurismaens forsta långfilm. Han skrev manuset tillsammans med sin bror Aki. "De arvlosa" ar en tidlos skildring av hur småskurken Manne, bonddrangen Harri och den vackra Veera kor en Volga genom de forsvinnande finlandska landskapen, med poliser och gangsters standigt på halarna. Den fartfyllda resan ackompanjeras av tidlosa låtar av bland annat Juice och Rauli Badding.

programme.title: Walking Tall
programme.desc: Nar det galler att skipa lag och ratt kan en man gora skillnad! Actionstjarnan Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson tar inga fångar nar han kampar for rattvisa och krossar korruption i denna berattelse om en man som tar stallning… och tar tillbaka sin stad!

programme.title: Don Jon
programme.desc: Don Martell ar en kille från New Jersey, vars liv kretsar kring familjen, vannerna, kyrkan – och porr. Formågan att ragga upp nya tjejer varje helg har gett honom smeknamnet ”Don Jon”. En kvall traffar han den snygga och romantiska Barbara som letar efter en underbar dromkille, en idealbild som ar valdigt långt från Don.

programme.title: Train to Busan
programme.desc: Ett oidentifierat virus slår till mot Korea och regeringen forklarar undantagstillstånd. Staden Busan har avvarjt virusutbrottet - och de på tåget från Seoul måste nu kampa for sin egen overlevnad.

programme.title: Arlington Road
programme.desc: I denna tata thriller moter vi collegeprofessorn Michael Faraday vars fru, en FBI-agent, dodats av medlemmar av en hogerextrem terroristgrupp. Nar Michael blir van med sina nya grannar, Oliver och Cheryl Lang, får han snart anledning att misstanka att något inte står ratt till. Han borjar forska i deras forflutna, men inte utan risk for sitt liv.

programme.title: Programmet fortsatter strax
programme.desc: Vi tar igen vår skonhetssomn! Stanna kvar for mer prisvard underhållning utvald av Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Staden Ember
programme.desc: Det har gått 200 år sedan den sista manniskan sokte skydd i den underjordiska staden Ember; men nu sviktar den stora generatorn.

programme.title: Rosso
programme.desc: Rosso, som skickligt kombinerar roadmovie och kriminaldrama, ar berattelsen om den sicilianska lonnmordaren Giancarlo Rosso, som har kommit till Finland for att leta efter sitt nasta mål, som råkar vara hans alskade Marja. Ovantat får Rosso hjalp med spårningen av Marjas bror Martti, trots att de inte ens delar ett gemensamt språk. På resan ingår både skrotningsuppdrag och några rån...

programme.title: Death At A Funeral
programme.desc: En komisk vriden historia om en dysfunktionell familj som samlas for att sorja sin patriarks bortgång. Daniels far har just avlidit och det enda han vill ar att genomfora begravningen som planerat, vilket inte ar det lattaste med en galen familj på halsen. Brorsan ar mest intresserad av att ragga tjejer, en annan slakting ar overtygad om att fadern ar vid liv i kistan och en mystisk pillerburk dyker standigt upp. Denna dråpliga komedi i brittisk tradition bjuder på många overraskningar.

programme.title: Flight World War II
programme.desc: Fångad I en strid mellan Tyska och Allierade styrkor kampar passagerarna i en modern 757 jet for att overleva efter att deras gjort en tidsresa tillbaka till 1940. I deras stravan att overleva lyckas de påverka historien och utgången av Andra Varldskriget.

programme.title: Wild Target
programme.desc: En klumpig yrkesmordare blir foralskad i sitt offer och måste skydda henne från både sin egen organisation och polisen.

programme.title: Hollywoods hemlighet
programme.desc: 1924 samlade mediamogulen William Randolph Hearst några av varldens mest kanda personligheter for en resa med sin yacht som resulterade i ett mord som forblev olost.

programme.title: The Dresser
programme.desc: En odesdiger natt på en liten engelsk teater under andra varldskriget, satter en trupp med kringresande skådespelare upp Shakespeares "King Lear".

programme.title: Underligare an fiktion
programme.desc: En IRS-revisor finner sig plotsligt foremål for berattande som bara han kan hora: berattande som borjar påverka hela hans liv; från hans arbete; till hans karleksintresse; till sin dod.

programme.title: Girls Just Want to Have Fun
programme.desc: Valkomna till en katolsk flickskola i hjartat av Chicago, staden som ar hem for USA:s popularaste dansshow: Dance TV! Utbytesstudenten Janey Glenn ar ett nervvrak nar hon blir presenterad for sina fnittrande klasskompisar av stranga syster Katherine. Men hon blir snabbt van med Lynne och deras gemensamma intresse for dans gor att de blir eld och lågor nar det utlyses en tavling dar ett nytt danspar till Dance TV ska utses. Janey och Lynne beslutar sig for att provdansa, men deras foraldrar ar mer skeptiska.

programme.title: No Good Deed (2002)
programme.desc: Polisen Jack Friar ar ute på Turk Street for att åt en god van leta ratt på en tonåring som rymt hemifrån. Men istallet kliver han ratt in hos ett gangstergang som planerar att råna en bank. Jack tas som gisslan och bevakas av ledaren Tyrones vackra flickvan Erin, samtidigt som de ovriga diskuterar vad de ska gora med Jack. Erin ar en mastare på att manipulera man, och snart borjar hon spela ett spel och krypa innanfor skinnet aven på Jack.

programme.title: USS Indianapolis: Men of Courage
programme.desc: I slutet av andra varldskriget fraktade den amerikanska tunga kryssaren USS Indianapolis i hemlighet en av de två atombomber som skulle komma att avsluta kriget. En japansk ubåt anfoll och sankte fartyget. USS Indianapolis uppdrag var så hemligt att fartyget inte anmaldes saknat och ingen visste att fartyget hade sankts forran forst fyra dagar senare. Av de 1197 ombord foljde nastan 300 med sitt fartyg i djupet. De overlevande blev liggande i de hajrika vattnen i Filippinska sjon och tvingades att utstå hunger, torst, hetta, hallucinationer, ideliga hajangrepp och många av sina skeppskamraters dod. Fem dagar senare levde bara 317 man och dessa kunde till slut raddas.

programme.title: Awake
programme.desc: En man vaknar på sjukhuset utan att minnas vem han ar och hur han har hamnat dar. Hans sjukskoterska (Eastwood) hittar ingen legitimation på honom och kallar honom bara John Doe (Rhys Meyers). Polisen brakar in på sjukhuset och anklagar John for att vara en seriemordare som har dodat flera unga kvinnor i trakten. Nar John ska foras till forhor lyckas han fly med hjalp av Diana, som ar saker på att han ar oskyldig. De kor till den senaste brottsplatsen for att hitta ledtrådar och svar som kan rentvå John från misstankarna. Den snalla sjukskoterskan tar reda på den skakande sanningen om Johns identitet och det nat av logner och svek som slutar i en sista kamp om hans overlevnad.

programme.title: The Rum Diary
programme.desc: Den rastlose New York-journalisten Paul trottnar på storstaden och soker sig till Karibien dar han får arbete på en tidningsredaktion som kampar for sin overlevnad i Puerto Rico. Oberakneliga kolleger och en fientligt installd lokalbefolkning blir snart hans vardag, liksom långa blota natter på de otaliga barerna. En natt moter Paul Chenault och blir besatt av den vackra kvinnan, som visar sig vara forlovad med den korrumperade affarsmannen Sanderson. Sanderson inser att han kan ha anvandning av Paul genom att betala honom att skriva fordelaktigt om ett av hans obskyra projekt – att bygga lyxhotell på en orord o vid kusten.
